rules: The approved Stage 6 visual references are the source of truth; do not replace them with generic Flutter layouts.
Home has two primary visual modules: one unified city-discovery card and one unified country-discovery card.
The city-discovery card contains the serif heading, selected city, decorative gold route line, dynamic popular places and the Find hotels button.
Popular places change automatically when the selected city changes and every place card is clickable.
The country-discovery card contains Popular destinations and Other cities together.
Place detail contains gallery image, name, address, short description, working hours, information badges and nearby hotels with approximate distance.
Place detail contains no map, no booking action and no favorite heart at this stage.
A nearby hotel row opens the normal hotel detail screen.
Welcome Start opens the authentication sheet with a smooth first-run slide animation.
Sign in, Create account and Continue as guest are three separate flows.
Guest profile shows Guest, hides Personal profile and Logout, and offers Sign in and Create account.
Registered profile uses entered user data and supports edit, logout and delete account.
Notification bells on home and catalog open Notifications.
Unread notification badges disappear after reading and all notification data disappears after Clear.
Catalog never substitutes Ashgabat hotels for another city.
Catalog map icon is removed.
Price, Rating and Availability pills sort the city hotel list; Filters opens a working filter sheet.
Hotel cards contain one favorite heart at the bottom right; the duplicate bookmark and top heart are removed.
Review count in hotel cards opens an in-catalog modal review window with a close button.
Hotel detail action buttons appear immediately below the base price in this order: Room prices, Availability request, disabled Online booking.
Hotel detail tabs are About and Amenities; the redundant Rooms and Reviews tabs are removed.
Hotel detail contains one review preview and All reviews opens a separate fully scrollable reviews screen.
Hotel detail scrolls completely and all review cards display full text.
Profile menu items Language, Notifications, Support and Privacy open working screens.
Personal profile Edit data opens an editable form and Delete account stays only inside Personal profile.
Online booking remains disabled and marked Soon in Ugur.
Availability request has no date or time and room types come from the selected hotel.
Real hotels, places, photos, distances and prices will later be managed through the admin panel.
Stage 7 visual references are the source of truth for Home, Favorites, Requests, Notifications, Profile and the bottom navigation.
The home brand header remains visible while the home content scrolls.
The Stage 7 bottom navigation uses rounded square icon containers, navy active background, gold active icon and a gold underline.
The bottom navigation uses the approved thin outline glyphs; active glyphs remain outlined in gold rather than becoming filled symbols.
On first opening Home, the city-discovery panel fills the available content viewport and the country-discovery panel appears only after scrolling.
Popular places and Popular destinations are real swipeable carousels with indicators that follow the current position.
The Popular destinations featured card has no bookmark button.
Favorites, Requests, Notifications and Profile use the Stage 7 navy, gold, white and pale-blue premium visual system.
Stage 7 is a visual redesign only; all working Stage 6 behavior must remain operational.
Stage 10 keeps the approved Stage 9 composition and only refines spacing, card height and compact geometry requested by the owner.
Home city-discovery content is shifted downward while the panel minimum height and the gap below the brand header are reduced.
Popular-place Show all is vertically aligned with the section heading.
Popular-destination caption strips are shorter, pagination dots are smaller and compact cards must not overflow.
Favorite hotel cards use one equal height; the operator clarification action must fit inside that shared height.
Only the Requests segmented control is slightly narrower; the rest of Requests remains unchanged.
Notifications and Profile top content are shifted downward without changing their functionality.
Stage 13 forces the compact phone layout for sub-1100px Flutter web viewports to prevent Safari from selecting oversized tablet geometry.
The owner may adjust overall interface scale and text scale from Profile > Interface size; defaults remain 100 percent.
The mobile viewport is patched during GitHub Pages deployment and the approved visual composition remains unchanged.
Stage 17 adds an owner-only designer panel without changing approved default geometry.
Five taps on the Ugur brand on Home open the live designer panel.
Designer values persist locally and can be exported as JSON for final hard-coding.
Stage 18A changes repository, validation and build infrastructure only; approved visual source files and default geometry remain unchanged.
